analysis_role: Specific hypothesis test, not predictor exploration. Test whether repeated U->D orientation transition probability is aligned with a predeclared two-axis present-day environmental shift: higher BIO15 and lower BIO1.

hypothesis.primary: Across the phylogeny, branches carrying greater U->D than D->U transition probability should align with a composite environmental shift toward higher precipitation seasonality (BIO15) and lower annual mean temperature (BIO1).
hypothesis.mechanistic_scope: This tests repeated transition-regime concordance. It does not test wetting, pollen viability, fitness, selection, adaptation, or historical transition-time climate.
not_a_hypothesis: BIO15 alone is the causal driver
BIO1 alone is the causal driver

method.discrete_model: Symmetric two-state CTMC. Estimate q separately for each topology and each counterfactual state map by maximum likelihood. Use exact edge joint posterior probabilities P(U,D) and P(D,U) conditional on all admitted tip states.
method.continuous_model: For BIO15 and BIO1 separately, z-score taxon centroids within panel and estimate internal values by Brownian squared-change minimization on the panel-spanning subtree using substitution branch lengths.
method.axis_statistic: For each edge, multiply environmental child-minus-parent shift by P(U,D)-P(D,U). Sum over edges and divide by total posterior change probability sum[P(U,D)+P(D,U)]. Positive means the environmental shift is aligned with the U->D direction.
method.primary_statistic: Unit-vector projection (S_BIO15 - S_BIO1)/sqrt(2), then median across the six accepted topologies.
method.null: Enumerate every tip-state assignment preserving panel U/D counts; recompute CTMC q and edge transition posteriors for every map. Environmental values and tree topology/branch lengths remain fixed.
method.exact_rank: One-sided exact state-map permutation fraction: number of count-preserving maps with six-topology median composite statistic >= observed, divided by all maps. Observed map is included.
method.single_axis_results: BIO15 and sign-reversed BIO1 exact ranks are reported as secondary decomposition only; they cannot replace the composite primary test.

method_validation.n10_observed_direction_required: BIO15 branchwise statistic positive and BIO1 branchwise statistic negative on all six topologies.
method_validation.failure_rule: If the new implementation cannot reproduce each legacy n=9 observed branchwise axis statistic within absolute tolerance 0.03 on all six topologies, stop without interpreting n5/n3 results.

decision_rule.supported: n5 observed composite statistic is positive on all six topologies and exact one-sided state-map permutation fraction <= 0.05.
decision_rule.directional_not_exceptional: n5 observed composite statistic is positive on all six topologies but exact fraction > 0.05.
decision_rule.direction_not_repeated: at least one n5 topology has a non-positive composite statistic.
decision_rule.n3_role: n3 is a sensitivity only and cannot rescue an unsupported n5 primary test.

claim_ceiling: A supported transition-regime test would show repeated phylogenetic concordance with the declared present-day environmental vector, not climatic causation.
Present-day taxon centroids are not transition-time environments.
No result identifies rain/wetting, UV, temperature, pollinators, or another mediator.
No result establishes adaptation, selection, independent origins, or transition-time fitness.
n>=5 and n>=3 remain relaxed occurrence-coverage sensitivities; the n>=10 ecology result remains the frozen primary present-day panel.
No new environmental axis may be added after result inspection.
